the data acquisition and positioning system for underwater mining machine were designed and tested successfully.
the data acquisition, positioning and control system developed for the underwater mining machines is capable of performing the mining operations as per the requirements of the mining machine.
the virtual instrumentation based data acquisition, control system and acoustic positioning system for underwater mining machine was successfully designed and tested in sea.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of control and positioning system for underwater crawler mining system.
the development of the control and positioning system for underwater mining machine.
the development of a control system for an underwater mining machine, which is capable of controlling and monitoring the machine and its operations from a mother ship, in real time.

the data acquisition system, control system and the positioning system of the crawler was found to be working satisfactorily in sea test and the system was able to provide the real-time data of the mining operation and positioning of the machine.
the data acquisition, positioning and control system of underwater mining machine is successfully tested at sea.
, the control and data acquisition system of the mining system was successfully developed and tested.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the control and data acquisition system of the underwater crawler machine is capable of performing the complex operation of the machine with high degree of flexibility.

the control and positioning system developed is capable to control the underwater mining machine in real time basis and provide online position status of mining machine in X, Y, Z direction with reference to mother ship.
the system was able to track the position and control the movement of the mining machine with reference to the vessel in real time basis and also record the data for post analysis.

the system can be used to control and monitor the operations of the mining machine and can be used as a platform to develop and test various control algorithms for future applications.
the data acquisition and positioning system developed is a flexible, modular, and scalable, and can be configured to meet the specific requirement of the mining system.
the control, data acquisition, positioning system and the GUI software developed for the deep sea crawler is flexible, robust and reliable.
